title: Grain-preserving reshape
brief: Preserve a declared grain through a reshape round trip.
instructions: Pivot return_totals by reason and unpivot back to month, reason, and quantity. Preserve actual zero rows and absent combinations; do not create zero rows for absent combinations.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter shows the source grain but omits quantities. The completed result must preserve genuine zeros and exclude absent combinations.

hints.text: A round trip preserves the unique input grain only when absence remains distinguishable from zero.
Keep NULL for absent pivot combinations; default unpivot then omits only those absent cells.
January wrong_item is a genuine zero row; January unwanted is absent.
